concept: Apple Business Manager custom apps and MDM distribution for IT audiences
summary: Source-anchored research for Apple Business Manager custom apps and MDM distribution for IT audiences. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: A Private app cannot be changed to Public (and Public cannot become Private); changing requires a new app record. Public can later become Unlisted after approval via an Apple request. (high confidence)

Private distribution (Custom Apps) is chosen in App Store Connect under Pricing and Availability > App Distribution Methods > Private, restricted to specified Organization IDs (or Apple Accounts for legacy VPP). Distribution is via MDM or redemption codes. (high confidence)

Custom apps go through standard App Review (typically 1-2 days); apps needing login must supply sample data/authentication to reviewers. Customer organizations must enable Custom Apps in settings, then find the app under Custom Apps in Apps and Books. (high confidence)
Customer admins find their Organization ID in Apple Business/School Manager under Preferences > Enrollment Information; the developer must collect it to target them. (medium confidence)

Apple announced Apple Business on 2026-03-24 and launched it 2026-04-14, merging Business Manager, Business Essentials and Business Connect into one free platform with built-in MDM in 200+ countries; Apple's own custom-apps guide is now titled 'Apple Business'. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-14)

Third-party MDMs (e.g. Intune) sync custom apps through location tokens (legacy VPP tokens), valid one year; a token works with one MDM at a time; device licensing (default for new Intune assignments) installs via MDM only without App Store sign-in; user licensing covers up to 5 devices per Apple Account. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-28)

On macOS, revoking a VPP license leaves the app usable but un-updatable; Apple removes it after a 30-day grace period. Reusing a token on another MDM can lose license assignment records. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-28)

Intune VPP tokens can use DDM management (iOS/iPadOS 18+) but DDM supports only Required/Uninstall, not Available; keep MDM for Available assignments and app-config policies. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-28)

A developer forum report shows a custom app assigned by device license failing on macOS InstallApplication with AMSErrorDomain code 301 'Invalid Status Code'; filed as FB11292074, no documented resolution (2022-era, example used iOS ID). (low confidence)
